full_description: Data Scientist 3 - (MLOPS, Machine Learning, Data Science) document.documentElement.classList.add('js') Visit our website Register with us View all jobs Data Scientist 3 - (MLOPS, Machine Learning, Data Science) Annapolis Junction, Maryland Data Scientist 3 - (MLOPS, Machine Learning, Data Science) Clearance: TS/SCI - Polygraph required Position ID: 25-8955-DS3 Location: Annapolis Junction, Maryland Description: A data scientist will develop machine learning, data mining, statistical and graph-based algorithms to analyze and make sense of datasets. Prototype or consider several algorithms and decide upon final model based on suitable performance metrics. Build models or develop experiments to generate data when training or example datasets are unavailable. Generate reports and visualizations that summarize datasets and provide data-driven insights to customers. Partner with subject matter experts to translate manual data analysis into automated analytics. Implement prototype algorithms within production frameworks for integration into analyst workflows. Produce data visualizations that provide insight into dataset structure and meaning. Work with subject matters experts (SMEs) to identify important information in raw data and develop scripts that extract this information from a variety of data formats (e.g., SQL tables, structured metadata, network logs). Incorporate SME input into feature vectors suitable for analytic development and testing. Translate customer qualitative analysis process and goals into quantitative formulations that are coded into software prototypes. Develop and implement statistical, machine learning, and heuristic techniques to create descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics. Develop statistical tests to make data-driven recommendations and decisions. Develop experiments to collect data or models to simulate data when required data are unavailable. Develop feature vectors for input into machine learning algorithms. Identify the most appropriate algorithm for a given dataset and tune input and model parameters. Evaluate and validate the performance of analytics using standard techniques and metrics (e.g. cross validation, ROC curves, confusion matrices). Oversee the development of individual analytic efforts and guide team in analytic development process. Guide analytic development toward solutions that can scale to large datasets. Partner with software engineers and cloud developers to develop production analytics. Develop and train machine learning systems based on statistical analysis of data characteristics to support mission automation. Lead a team of data scientists in the development of multiple analytic efforts. Work with customers and SMEs to define analytic requirements and guide the team in formulating analytics that meet requirements. Guide the transition of prototyped analytics to production system. Understand emerging machine learning and pattern recognition algorithms and guide a team of data scientists in integrating state-of-the-art algorithms into solutions. Delegate analysis responsibilities to one or more team members and monitor performance. Develop machine learning, data mining, statistical and graph-based algorithms to analyze and make sense of datasets. Position Required Skills: In addition to the standard DS3 labor category requirements, the MT&E team is also seeking significant MLOPS and Data Science background. DS3 Qualifications: A minimum of ten (10) years of experience in two (2) or more of the following: designing/implementing machine learning, data mining, advanced analytical algorithms, advanced statistical analysis, artificial intelligence, or software engineering with data analysis software such as R, Python, SAS, or MATLAB. Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited college or university in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, mathematics, operations research, engineering or computer science). An additional four (4) years of experience in software development, cloud development, analyzing datasets, or developing descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics can be substituted for a Bachelor's degree. A Master’s Degree from an accredited college or university in a quantitative discipline can be substituted for two (2) years of experience for a total of eight (8) years of experience required. A Doctoral Degree from an accredited college or university in a quantitative discipline can be substituted for four (4) years of experience for a total of six (6) years of experience required. The department partners closely with customers to develop robust Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) strategies, enabling successful progression through preclinical development, clinical development, regulatory submission, commercialization, and lifecycle management. R&D is responsible for the development, optimization, scale-up, technology transfer, and continuous improvement of peptide manufacturing processes and related technologies. The organization combines deep expertise in peptide chemistry, process development, analytical sciences, manufacturing science, and engineering to deliver innovative, scalable, and commercially viable solutions that address complex technical challenges and accelerate development timelines. In addition to process and technology development, the department operates laboratory and pilot-scale manufacturing capabilities supporting both non-GMP and cGMP production activities. These capabilities enable rapid process evaluation, process characterization, clinical supply manufacturing, technology transfer, and manufacturing support while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and scientific rigor. As a recognized leader in peptide development and manufacturing, R&D drives innovation through the evaluation, development, and implementation of advanced chemical processes, automation technologies, digital solutions, and next-generation manufacturing platforms. The organization continually explores emerging technologies and novel scientific approaches to strengthen Bachem's capabilities, improve process performance, and expand industry-leading CDMO services. Working collaboratively across global R&D sites and in partnership with Manufacturing, Analytical Development, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Project Management, and Commercial teams, the department plays a critical role in delivering innovative solutions that support customer success, operational excellence, and the long-term strategic growth of Bachem. The Research Scientist is responsible for the design, execution, analysis, and documentation of customer-driven process development projects, research initiatives, and technology development activities supporting peptide manufacturing processes. Working under general guidance of the (Sr.) Manager, the Research Scientist applies advanced scientific expertise to develop mechanistic understanding of peptide synthesis and purification processes, solve complex technical challenges, and generate data-driven recommendations for robust, scalable, and commercially viable manufacturing solutions. The Research Scientist conducts innovative research in peptide chemistry, evaluates and implements emerging technologies and automated development platforms, and supports the advancement of manufacturing capabilities through process optimization and lifecycle management activities. The Research Scientist serves as a technical contributor within project teams, facilitates knowledge transfer across sites, and collaborates closely with Manufacturing, Analytical Development, Quality, Engineering, and Project Management functions to expand organizational expertise and advance scientific excellence in peptide development and manufacturing. W hat you will do Design, execute, and troubleshoot peptide API development projects, including research, and process investigations. Independently develop, optimize, and evaluate peptide synthesis, purification, and manufacturing processes to improve process performance, robustness, and scalability. Apply scientific expertise to identify and resolve technical challenges while generating data-driven recommendations to support project objectives and continuous process improvement. Take ownership of assigned projects and deliverables by ensuring timely, quality-focused, and cost-effective execution aligned with organizational and customer objectives. Apply advanced scientific principles and technical knowledge to solve chemical and process-related challenges. Prepare technical reports, development summaries, presentations, protocols, risk assessments, and supporting documentation for internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate effectively in cross-functional project teams and serve as a technical resource within assigned areas of responsibility. Identify opportunities for process improvements, operational efficiencies, and implementation of new technologies and methodologies. Maintain compliance with applicable quality systems, SOPs, safety requirements, and regulatory expectations. Provide technical training and knowledge transfer within the department as appropriate. Qualifications Master's Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology with 3+ years of experience in peptide research, manufacturing, and/or process development or PhD in Chemistry or related fields with 0-3 years of experience in peptide research, manufacturing and/or process development. Strong knowledge of organic chemistry, peptide chemistry, process development, and pharmaceutical manufacturing principles. Thorough understanding of peptide synthesis, purification, isolation, and associated analytical techniques. Demonstrated ability to design experiments, analyze complex data sets, and develop scientifically sound conclusions and recommendations. Knowledge of process development activities including feasibility studies, process optimization, scale-up, technology transfer, manufacturing support, and troubleshooting. Familiarity with laboratory and manufacturing technologies commonly used for peptide development and production, including synthesis reactors, chromatography systems, lyophilization, and related equipment. Strong technical writing skills with the ability to prepare reports, protocols, risk assessments, presentations, and other scientific documentation for diverse audiences. Effective verbal communication and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex scientific topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional and multidisciplinary project teams. Strong organizational, planning, and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to independently develop and implement effective technical solutions. Ability to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and support implementation of new technologies, methodologies, and business processes. Working knowledge of cGMP requirements, quality systems, data integrity principles, and applicable regulatory expectations. Commitment to maintaining a safe work environment through adherence to Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) requirements and proactive identification of potential risks. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and scientific software platforms, including the ability to rapidly learn and effectively utilize new systems and technologies. Ability to train, coach, and share technical knowledge with colleagues while fostering a collaborative and continuous learning environment. Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and ownership, with the ability to work independently while understanding the broader objectives of projects and organizational goals.
